name: facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint_sampling/utils/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.build_atomic_graph: build a fully connected molecule graph with edge indices and one-hot atomic species from an atom list
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.subtract_com_batch: subtract the center of mass from batched particle positions using a batch index tensor
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.convert_graph_to_vector: convert batched particle positions from graph format to a flat vector for standard torch models
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.create_prebatched_dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset wrapper that yields pre-batched input and target tuples by index
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.subtract_com_vector: subtract the center of mass from particle position samples reshaped as a vector array

facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.init_distributed_mode: init a PyTorch distributed process group from env vars or SLURM and set the NCCL backend
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.setup_for_distributed: setup print to only output on the master process with timestamps in distributed training
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.is_dist_avail_and_initialized: check if PyTorch distributed is available and initialized before calling distributed APIs
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.get_world_size: get the total number of processes in the distributed group or return 1 if not initialized
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.get_rank: get the current process rank in the distributed group or return 0 if not initialized

facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.generate_conformers_from_graph_state: generate RDKit molecule conformers from a PyTorch graph state tensor with optional geometry relaxation using ASE LBFGS
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.read_rdkit_mols_from_smiles: read a SMILES string and generate multiple 3D conformers using RDKit ETKDG with optional MMFF optimization and ASE relaxation
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.calc_rmsd_between_molecule_lists: calculate pairwise RMSD between lists of generated and reference RDKit molecules with automatic atom mapping and hydrogen removal
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.calc_performance_stats_from_rmsd: compute coverage recall, coverage precision, AMR recall, and AMR precision metrics from an RMSD array across threshold ranges
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.integrate_sde_all_states: integrate an SDE over all time steps using Euler-Maruyama with uniform or quadratic-linear discretization and return graph states and controls

facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.convert_matplotlib_figure_to_pil_image: convert a matplotlib figure object to a PIL Image using fig2img
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.compute_pairwise_interatomic_distances: compute pairwise interatomic distances from particle position samples using interatomic_dist
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.generate_dataset_visualization_figure: generate a histogram figure of interatomic distances and energies using get_dataset_fig
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.convert_positions_to_rdkit_molecule: convert atom positions and types to an RDKit Mol object with SMILES using to_mol
facebookresearch_adjointsampling/adjoint.visualize_molecular_conformations: visualize generated molecular conformations as a grid image with SMILES legends using visualize_conformations
